```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister, Parameter, ParameterVector
import numpy as np
from math import pi

# Define input parameters
inputs = ParameterVector('input', 8)

# Define weight parameters
weights = ParameterVector('weight', 8)

# Create a 4-qubit quantum register
qr = QuantumRegister(4, 'q')

# Create a quantum circuit
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, name='VQC Circuit')

# Apply feature-encoding rotations
qc.ry(inputs[0], qr[0])
qc.rz(inputs[1], qr[0])
qc.ry(inputs[2], qr[1])
qc.rz(inputs[3], qr[1])
qc.ry(inputs[4], qr[2])
qc.rz(inputs[5], qr[2])
qc.ry(inputs[6], qr[3])
qc.rz(inputs[7], qr[3])

# Apply CX gates
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[2])
qc.cx(qr[1], qr[3])

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Apply ansatz rotations
qc.ry(weights[0], qr[0])
qc.rz(weights[1], qr[1])
qc.ry(weights[2], qr[2])
qc.rz(weights[3], qr[3])
qc.rz(weights[4], qr[0])
qc.ry(weights[5], qr[1])
qc.rz(weights[6], qr[2])
qc.ry(weights[7], qr[3])
```

```python
def bernstein_vazirani_setup(n):
    qr = QuantumRegister(n + 1, 'q')
    cr = ClassicalRegister(n, 'c')
    circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
    circuit.x(qr[n])
    circuit.h(qr[n])
    circuit.h(qr[:n])
    circuit.barrier()
    return circuit

n = 4  # example size
circuit = bernstein_vazirani_setup(n)
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create a quantum register with 3 qubits and a classical register with 3 bits
qreg = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
creg = ClassicalRegister(3, 'c')

# Create a quantum circuit
qc = QuantumCircuit(qreg, creg)

# Initialize q0 with X
qc.x(qreg[0])

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Create a Bell pair on q1 and q2
qc.h(qreg[1])
qc.cx(qreg[1], qreg[2])

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Apply Alice's operations
qc.cx(qreg[0], qreg[1])
qc.h(qreg[0])

# Measure q0 and q1 into c0 and c1
qc.measure(qreg[0], creg[0])
qc.measure(qreg[1], creg[1])

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Apply Bob's operations conditioned on the measurement outcomes
qc.cx(qreg[1], qreg[2]).c_if(creg[1], 1)
qc.z(qreg[2]).c_if(creg[0], 1)

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Measure q2 into c2
qc.measure(qreg[2], creg[2])
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create a quantum register with 4 qubits and a classical register with 2 bits
qr = QuantumRegister(4, 'q')
cr = ClassicalRegister(2, 'c')

# Create a quantum circuit
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

# Initialize input qubits to |1
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.x(qr[1])

# Compute sum and carry using CNOT and Toffoli gates
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[2])  # sum = a ^ b
qc.cx(qr[1], qr[2])  # sum = a ^ b
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[3])  # carry = a & b

# Measure the result qubits
qc.measure(qr[2], cr[0])  # measure sum
qc.measure(qr[3], cr[1])  # measure carry
```
